name: Seraphina Lazuli
source:
At twenty-two, Seraphina finally began taking the steps to publish her graphic novel based on a fairytale she had written as a child. When she is suddenly transported to the world she once loved, she is left to escape with the help of her own characters. Can Seraphina find her way home in time before she is stuck in her fairytale forever?

[From [url=https://rooftopsrevolution.itch.io/written-in-the-stars]itch.io[/url]]
